## Architecture boundaries

Tick each, or explain why it does not apply.

- [ ] **No direct LLM-to-SQL path.** SQL is still generated by a deterministic
      tool from the Metric IR.
- [ ] **Scenario vs Capability preserved.** Business meaning is in the scenario
      skill; mechanism is in the capability/tool. No scenario-specific SQL tool
      was added.
- [ ] **IR change is additive** (optional field with a default), or a migration
      and version bump are included and justified.
- [ ] **Canonical hash covers new IR fields**, so distinct metrics cannot
      collide.
- [ ] **Governance unchanged.** Approval / promotion / release gates still
      require explicit human decisions.
- [ ] **Test expectations are hand-computed**, not derived by calling production
      code.

## Safety

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or real credentials added
- [ ] No real customer / company / person names or real identifiers
- [ ] No real data files bundled — demo data is synthetic
- [ ] `uv run --frozen python scripts/check_open_source_safety.py` passes
